relevant_laws.quote: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle in any other alley in such a manner, or under such conditions as to leave available less than 10 feet of the width of the alley for the free movement of vehicular traffic.
relevant_laws.notes: The selected park branch is within the clause; qualifying alley and local ordinance require source review.
